meta.name: alternative-scoring
meta.description: Score each candidate alternative against all criteria to produce a score matrix.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对候选方案按多维度打分，生成评分矩阵
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个备选方案中做量化比较
copy.tagline_en: Score each candidate against all criteria to produce a score matrix
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to compare multiple alternatives quantitatively

howto.what: Claude会将每个候选方案按各个标准逐一打分，生成一张完整的评分矩阵（方案×标准），每个分数都附带一句简短的理由。
howto.when: 当你提供一组候选方案、明确的评分标准和对应的权重时触发。

say.text: 请用这些标准和权重给候选人打分。
say.note: Claude会生成评分矩阵并附理由。

say.text: 对这几个选项按成本、速度、质量评分。

howto.what_en: Claude will score each candidate alternative against all criteria to produce a complete scoring matrix (alternatives x criteria), each score with a brief rationale.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a list of candidates, criteria, and weights for scoring.

say_en.text: Please score these candidates using these criteria and weights.
say_en.note: Claude will output a scoring matrix with rationales.

say_en.text: Score these options by cost, speed, and quality.
